android.desc:
The Aam Admi Party has had a stunning debut in Delhi and is ready to take on the national elections in India. Join them in AAP : The Sweeper by sweeping the streets of the major cities in India.Sweep away the dishonest politicians and corrupt bureaucrats to jails and court all the while making sure that you don't let them escape the country via airports.Read about you performance in the dynamic game end newspaper. Stay true to your name by avoiding sweeping of civilians.Recruit honest politicians to join your cause and thereby unlock new cities. Gain support of voters to spread your influence all out India and fight at the national level. A special tutorial told via Arvind Kejriwal helps you get familiarize with the game. After that get ready to take on politicians like Narendra Modi and Rahul Gandhi.Help Aam Admi Party overthrow established parties like Congress, BJP. 

Features:
	Unique sweeping mechanic
	4 + 1 levels
	Play based newspaper report.
	Objectives which increase your TRP
	Google Play Services based leader boards and achievements.

Please report any issues to solvevolve@gmail.com
